prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Deep Orbit cinematic cel-shaded narrative,1536x1024 landscape. First portraits establish fixed canonical identities, facial morphology and age, eyes/nose/jaw, hair, costume and equipment. Next approved room master for ROOM ARCHITECTURE ONLY, not diagrams or colors. Last reference exact restaging target. Restrained clean outlines and muted sage #6BAA8A, aged brass #A89060, charcoal/navy, natural skin, modest practical lights. No glossy or neon lime. Balanced stylized adults with coherent neck/shoulders/torso, plausible arm chains, exactly two five-finger hands each, natural chair/table support. Faces visible, eyes follow work or other crew, candid action and subtle lively emotion, no camera gaze or presentation portrait. Screens physically face actual reader; camera beside reader sees same front face. Every label, cell, line, arrow follows correct surface perspective. Remove outward handheld displays. Peripheral screens inactive. Only specified content, no fake numerical findings or extra diagrams.  Demir single earpiece stays on anatomical RIGHT ear; Farah lens stays over anatomical LEFT eye. Nazari and Mirza have no monocle or earpiece. Only exact named cast. Demir seated at bridge workbench, leaning forward to read the console with a focused hopeful smile. Both hands naturally typing on keyboard, feet supported and normal knees belowdesk. Monitor at RIGHT faces him and camera. Title "Pipeline rehearsal". Three stages as a simple left-to-right flow "Validate input" then "Await process" then "Pass result onward". Footer "Invalid input: stop and name the stage". Smallstatus "Eight-sample diagnostic: pending". No successcheck, no modelaccuracyclaim. Preserve canonical face and muted room.
